# isme.gg

> A cinema-first media app for Android and Android TV, designed for discovering movies, Filipino cinema, TV series, anime and K-drama and playing authorized media.

## Information
- [Website](https://isme.gg/): product features, supported device targets and category overview.
- [FAQ](https://isme.gg/#faq): content availability, privacy, platform support and advertising.
- [Project releases](https://github.com/bastilavarias/isme.gg/releases): available builds and release details.

## Accuracy notes
The landing page is a private design preview until public launch. Artwork and streaming service logos are illustrative, not evidence of access or official partnerships. Media availability depends on authorized sources and region. Privacy-first does not mean anonymous: peer-to-peer networking can expose IP addresses.
